spanish: Y si cabra su ofrenda, y la acercará delante de Jehová.

findings.issue: The object suffix is 3ms; Spanish la is feminine, matching ofrenda/cabra rather than the masculine suffix.

notes: Verbless וְאִם עֵז קָרְבָּנוֹ is left without a copula; hiphil 3ms, לפני, and Jehová match the tokens.
